caption: Your AI assistant in YunLeFun
cloudDescription: Conversations, models and groups live in DSH Web.
cloudHint: Uses your existing SSH keys. Only the host alias is saved.
closeHint: Close the window to keep Yun in the tray.
noLogs: Refresh to load recent local logs.
personaHint: Switching starts a new conversation at the next task; active tasks finish first.
personaSaved: Persona selection saved on the server.
noPersonas: Load the current persona or manage cards in DSH Web.
savedPathsHint: File paths only. Credentials are never copied into the app.
errorSettingsInvalid: Invalid client settings. Existing file was retained.
errorRuntime: Node or the el-bot CLI was not found. Check local settings.
errorTimeout: The request timed out. Refresh to check its state.
errorResponse: The service returned an invalid response.
errorTooLarge: The response exceeded its size limit.
errorSshHost: Use an existing SSH alias: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only.
errorSsh: Could not connect. Check SSH, host keys and local port 13080.
errorCloudUrl: The server returned an unexpected Web address.
errorCloudUnavailable: Cloud DSH has not provided its Web entry.
errorPersona: Install the @el-bot/dsh plugin on the cloud host first.
errorProgram: App not found. Set its full path in Settings.
errorPlatform: Configure an executable path for this platform.
errorState: Refresh the bot status before this action.
errorBrowser: Could not open the default browser.
cloudUrlHint: Use an HTTPS login address. Sign in on the server; no model key is stored here.
connectionRequired: Configure your cloud connection in Settings.
errorConnectionAddress: Enter an HTTPS address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
app.name: Yun
connect.title: Connect to your cloud
connect.subtitle: Your conversations, wherever you are.
connect.instructions: Generate a five-minute pairing code on your cloud server with yun-bot-mobile --pair.
connect.security: Model keys stay in the cloud. This device keeps a revocable credential in Keychain.
sessions.empty.detail: Start a conversation or continue one from your cloud.
chat.empty.detail: Messages and context are saved by your cloud DSH.
chat.too_long: Use up to 4,000 characters per message.
chat.model.next_request: The model change applies to the next model request. The current step keeps using the previous model.
chat.model.switch_failed: Could not switch models. The previous model is still selected.
model.setup.title: Models & API Keys
model.setup.settings.detail: Learn about cloud setup, conversation models, and key storage.
model.setup.cloud: Models run on your connected cloud
model.setup.intro: If models are already available, you can start chatting. To use your own API key, add a model provider to the connected cloud instance.
model.setup.step1.detail: Use the button below to open DSH Web for your connected instance with your existing device pairing.
model.setup.step2: Add a provider and API key
model.setup.step2.detail: In the account menu, open Settings → Models → Add model provider. Choose OpenAI, DeepSeek, or another provider, enter its API key, and save.
model.setup.step3: Return to chat and choose a model
model.setup.step3.detail: Return to Conversations, open a chat, and tap the model name by the input field. If no models are available, tap Refresh to reload the catalog.
model.setup.connect_first: Pair your device in Settings → Connect to cloud before opening cloud configuration.
model.setup.session.detail: The chat picker changes only this conversation and saves the selection in the cloud. Changes apply to the next model request; a running request keeps its original model.
model.setup.default.detail: Used by conversations without their own selection. To change the default for new conversations, adjust the cloud default model configuration. Existing conversation selections take priority.
model.setup.storage.detail: API keys stay on the connected cloud server, which calls the model. They are never sent to your iPhone or iPad.
model.setup.device.detail: Device access credentials are stored in the local Keychain. Models and keys are configured separately for each cloud instance and do not sync automatically.
model.setup.empty: Add a model provider in the cloud, then refresh the model list.
model.setup.hint.title: Connected to your cloud
model.setup.hint.detail: Switch models in chat. To configure your own API key, open cloud DSH settings.
status.description: Your cloud keeps the bot connected. Pull to refresh the current connection state.
settings.disconnect.title: Disconnect from the cloud?
settings.disconnect.detail: The app removes its credential and requests cloud revocation. Conversations remain in the cloud.
settings.security: You can also revoke this device from your cloud server with yun-bot-mobile --devices and --revoke.
error.server: Enter an HTTPS server address without a path or credentials.
error.unauthorized: This device credential has expired or was revoked. Pair again.
error.pairing: The pairing code is invalid, expired, or already used.
error.rate_limit: Too many pairing attempts. Try again in a minute.
error.unavailable: Cannot reach your cloud. Pull to try again.
error.response: Your server returned an unsupported response.
error.rejected: Your cloud could not accept this request. Try again shortly.
error.restore: Unable to restore the saved device connection.
error.storage: Secure storage is unavailable. Check the app signing and try again.
chat.delivery_unknown: Delivery is unconfirmed. Retry with the same request ID.
connect.disconnect_failed: Could not revoke the device. Reconnect or revoke it on the server.
account.title: YunLeFun account
account.hint: Link your account to sync language preferences. Conversations stay on the paired cloud.
account.not_configured: Account sync is not configured on this cloud yet.
error.account_not_configured: Account sync is not configured on this cloud yet.
error.account_unauthorized: Account authorization expired. Sign in again.
error.account_response: The account service returned an invalid response.
account.discovery_hint: Sign in to see online clouds linked to your account. Each connection still gets its own revocable device credential.
account.instances_empty: No online clouds are linked to this account.
account.discovery_not_configured: Account-based discovery is not configured on this cloud yet.
status.bot.title: A little cloud, by your side
status.bot.subtitle: A gentle swipe, and I’ll follow along.
status.bot.hint: Scroll down to play with Cloud
status.bot.scroll.title: Following your rhythm
status.bot.scroll.detail: Scroll up or down to make Cloud sway. Pause, and it gently settles back into place.
status.bot.tap.title: Say a little hello
status.bot.tap.detail: Tap Cloud for a happy squint, or drag around it to show it the world.
status.bot.accessibility: Little Cloud, tap to say hello
tools.title: Phone tools
tools.mode.detail: Conversations run in the cloud. Phone tools run on this device when you ask.
tools.controller.detail: Install and start the iCTRL runner on this phone, then refresh. Keep remote access off. After a restart, prepare its runtime again.
tools.pair.waiting: Approve “Yun · iPhone” in the iCTRL notification on this phone.
tools.smoke.detail: Opens example.com in Chrome, reads its visible page, then returns here. Chrome must be installed. This takes over the screen briefly.
tools.result.detail: Results stay in memory on this screen. Nothing is uploaded to the cloud.
tools.error.unavailable: Cannot reach iCTRL. Start its runner and refresh.
tools.error.incompatible: This controller uses an unsupported protocol.
tools.error.denied: Pairing was refused or timed out.
tools.error.busy: Another pairing request is pending. Wait before trying again.
tools.error.key_rejected: The controller did not accept this key. Check the phone clock or pair again.
tools.error.response: The controller response could not be verified.
tools.error.too_large: The controller response exceeded the size limit.
tools.error.execution: The task did not finish. Check the phone and try again.
web.title: DSH Web
web.error.title: Unable to open DSH Web
web.error.connection: Check the cloud connection, then reconnect.
phone.detail: Allows opening Chrome, Safari and Settings. Returns to Yun by default. Keep Yun open to receive tasks.
phone.error.connection: Phone control disconnected. Reopen Yun and enable it again.
chat.info.title: Conversation info
chat.info.identifiers.detail: OpenIDs are QQ platform identifiers, not QQ account or group numbers. Select the text or use the copy button.
chat.info.unavailable: Could not refresh details. Existing conversation information is shown.
chat.info.name: Name
chat.info.forbidden: QQ has not granted access to this information endpoint.
persona.scope: Applies to this cloud instance’s QQ bot. Switching starts a new conversation at the next task; active tasks continue. Regular DSH Web chats are unaffected.
persona.empty.detail: Import a Markdown card and preview its settings before enabling it.
persona.author: Author
persona.saved: Saved. The next QQ task will use the selected persona.
persona.imported: Version saved. Preview it, then choose Enable this version.
persona.importHint: UTF-8 Markdown up to 32 KiB, with optional YAML metadata. Cards are saved to this cloud instance and are not enabled automatically.
persona.error.unavailable: Native personas are unavailable. Upgrade the mobile service and enable the DSH personas plugin.
persona.error.size: Persona cards must be no larger than 32 KiB.
persona.error.file: Choose a nonempty UTF-8 Markdown file.
persona.error.input: Check the persona source, HTTPS URL, repository path and version.
persona.error.operation: Persona operation failed. Check the Markdown format, source availability and cloud library, then retry.
sessions.error.operation: The result is unconfirmed. Refresh to check the conversation, then try again.
sessions.delete.final_detail: This cannot be undone and affects all devices. The group entry stays available. Backups and copies in other conversations are unaffected.
sessions.error.active: This conversation still has active work. Wait for it to finish and try again.
sessions.error.archived: This conversation is archived. Restore it from the list to continue chatting.
sessions.error.confirmation: The conversation changed or confirmation expired. Confirm deletion again.
sessions.error.owner: An older runtime still owns this conversation. Restart the cloud service and retry deletion.
sessions.error.upgrade: Upgrade the cloud conversation service to use this feature.
groups.title: Bot groups
groups.scope: Group entries stay available after chat history is deleted. Only recorded groups are shown; this list may be incomplete.
groups.error.forbidden: The bot left this group or chat is not allowed.
sessions.historical: This is group chat history. Open the current conversation from Bot groups.
qq.capture.notice: Only group messages received and bot send attempts recorded since this feature was enabled are shown.
qq.empty.detail: Received messages and bot sends will appear here.
qq.compose: Write the exact message as the bot
qq.preview.detail: The bot will send the exact text below. It appears as a bot message in the group.
qq.pausing.detail: Stopping active work and in-flight replies before manual sending is enabled.
qq.automatic.detail: The bot follows its existing reply policy. Take over to send your own text as the bot.
qq.manual.detail: Leaving this screen does not end the handoff. Resume explicitly or wait for expiry.
qq.history: This is historical chat. Open the current conversation from Bot groups to take over.
qq.delivery.unknown: Delivery is unknown. Check QQ first to avoid duplicate messages.
qq.permission.unknown: Proactive permission is unverified. The QQ receipt determines the result.
qq.permission.denied: The latest proactive send was rejected. Check group permissions.
qq.error.upgrade: Upgrade the cloud service to enable native group chat.
qq.error.pausing: The current reply has not fully stopped. Retry pausing shortly.
qq.error.preview: The send request expired or the conversation changed. Send again.
qq.error.lease: The handoff ended or expired. Take over again.
qq.error.reply: No recent message is available for a reply. Wait for one or explicitly choose proactive sending.
qq.error.proactive: QQ rejected proactive sending. Check the group permissions.
qq.error.sending: A send is still pending. Wait for its receipt before resuming automatic replies.
qq.error.unavailable: Group history or handoff is temporarily unavailable. Refresh and try again.
sessions.error.deleted: This conversation was deleted. Start again from Bot groups.
status.host.title: Remote host
status.host.unavailable: Host metrics are unavailable. Configure the host collector to enable them.
status.host.waiting: Connect to view host resource usage.
status.host.stale: The last sample is shown. Refresh to check the host collector.
status.host.scope: Host-wide resources, sampled every 15 seconds. Memory and disk show used / total.
status.remote.unavailable: The remote service has not provided runtime information.
status.remote.title: Remote environment
status.remote.waiting: Connect to view remote runtime information.
status.remote.scope: Container deployments describe the container environment. Memory is the remote service process RSS.
model.setup.points.detail: Open cloud DSH, choose YunLeFun AI in the sidebar, and explicitly authorize point charges. Then choose the YunLeFun AI points provider in chat. This requires the cloud points plugin and server integration.
model.setup.points.scope: Authorization belongs to this cloud instance. Its paired phones, Macs, and QQ bot share the authorized account balance. Signing in alone does not grant point access, and low balance never switches to a personal key automatically.
